# Bundled MI-GAN model

This directory contains the pre-converted MI-GAN-512-Places2 ONNX model linked
by the official `Picsart-AI-Research/MI-GAN` project.

- Project: <https://github.com/Picsart-AI-Research/MI-GAN>
- Model: <https://huggingface.co/andraniksargsyan/migan>
- Model revision: `1538c135034b8cfe7a8472f34d09c8a5a45b17a7`
- Model SHA-256: `593eba0b7e04730f1b61c0a3cbca68d97d8d6a7ff5c6a44a7b9d7fcd880fc5ae`
- License: MIT; the license text is included as `LICENSE`.

Clipart Generator runs this model locally through ONNX Runtime only for a
user-confirmed bounded visible-mark region. It does not contact Hugging Face at
runtime.
